name: banner
title: Banner
description: Status message built from parts (Banner, BannerTitle, BannerDescription, BannerActions, BannerAction): 5 statuses (filled glyphs for info, success, warning and error; the icon set's outline info icon for default), low or high contrast, primary, secondary and ghost actions (the library Button) that trail a one-line banner (primary at the edge) and drop under a description (primary first), a dismiss that collapses its height, and a fixed variant that sticks full-bleed to the top of the page.
docs: Docs & live playground: https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/docs/banner. Craft notes, the color, layout and motion decisions to keep when you change it: https://github.com/mickadesign/fluid-functionalism/blob/main/skills/fluid-functionalism/references/craft.md#banner.
